title: Amazon Mining Watch AI tracks illegal gold mining — 6,000ha new scars in protected areas
snippet: Amazon Mining Watch uses Sentinel-2 10m imagery + AI (99.2% accuracy) to detect mining scars. 6,000ha new mining scars in protected areas/Indigenous territories in Q4 2025. Ecuador Indigenous lands: mining deforestation nearly tripled Aug-Dec 2025. Platform now covers entire Amazon basin. Also expanding to Africa (Africa Mining Watch).
tag_reason: 신규: Amazon Mining Watch AI 플랫폼의 아마존 전역 불법 채굴 탐지 결과. 이전 보고서에 관련 항목 없음. Sentinel-2 위성 데이터 기반.

entities.name: 아마존 보호구역 불법 금 채굴 6,000ha — Sentinel-2 AI 탐지
